residential_colleges.name: Residential Colleges
residential_colleges.hours: Lunch: 11:00 AM - 2:00 PM | Dinner: 4:30 PM - 8:00 PM
residential_colleges.summary: Dunham features daily rotating hot entrees & vegan specialties. Headington hosts specialty bars (Wing Bar, Seafood Bar, Mac & Cheese) plus everyday made-to-order classics.

couch_restaurants.name: Couch Restaurants
couch_restaurants.hours: Lunch: 10:30 AM - 2:30 PM | Dinner: 4:30 PM - 9:00 PM
couch_restaurants.summary: The legendary OU dining center with the world’s only all-you-care-to-eat Chick-fil-A, Shanghai Stir-Fry, Chef’s Choice entrees, Casa Del Sol, Athens Café, and Crimson Creamery.

wagner_dining_hall.name: Wagner Dining Hall
wagner_dining_hall.hours: Lunch: 11:00 AM - 1:30 PM | Dinner (Sun-Thu): 5:00 PM - 7:30 PM
wagner_dining_hall.summary: High-performance nutrition featuring daily scratch-made hot entrees, seasoned meats & grains, custom Made-to-Order stir-fry/pasta/grill/curry, and fresh deli/salad bars.
